metadata.description: Plugin marketplace for the Issuegraph toolchain.

plugins.name: issuegraph-skills
plugins.description: Task-shaped skills over the `issuegraph` CLI, so the three things done constantly are a call with a memorable name: SELECTION (order a candidate set, answer what is ready, and why a P0 is held), CREATION (render a correct block on a new issue, including a decomposition's leaves), and GROOMING (validate, repair an inert block, refresh generated edges). Each composes the CLI and re-implements no parsing. They lead with the traps that fail silently: `parse` and `validate` exit 0 on an unreadable block, so `state` is the field to read; and an empty `ready` result with a non-empty `underRead` means "I could not tell", not "nothing is ready".
